findings: Author reference README identifies minor changes from original EVM and provides permission language, but no separate LICENSE file is present in inspected complete tree.
Python2/libMR implementation fits per-point lower-tail Weibulls and greedily reduces same-class coverage; reference fit allocates the full pairwise distance matrix and uses every CPU core.

For1270025 rows, one float64 square distance matrix alone requires12903708005000 bytes (11.736 TiB); this is an analytical estimate, not a measurement. Direct full-row reference execution is infeasible under4GiB.
Chunking/subsampling, distance scaling, tail size, fusion, reduction and open-set threshold would require explicit choices and fidelity checks; no runtime execution.
